title: Chapter 366 Reversal
content:
Chapter 366 Reversal

The fact of this guess can't help but chill everyone's heart. They looked at the general high in the air, and their eyes couldn't help but change.

Similarly, those black mist people who were running for their lives not far away saw the golden red giant sword disappear, and then saw the horrified side below them, and immediately realized what happened.

"Hahaha, let me just say, how could such a powerful giant sword come out of nowhere, there must be some kind of medium in it. As expected, such a powerful giant sword was actually a living sacrifice of so many powerful soldiers. condensed.

Now that the power of the blood sacrifice has been exhausted, the golden red giant sword can't hold it anymore, and it just dissipates. It even has 5,000 second-level elite soldiers on board, which is really courageous. "

The leader of the black mist man did not flee after seeing the scene, but returned a certain distance, laughed a few times, and said.

The other four remaining Black Mist people also stopped, and after hearing what their leader said, they all nodded in unison, and they all agreed very much.

It does take a lot of courage.

After all, it is a 5,000-tier Tier 2 Legion. To gather such a powerful force, the price paid, the energy wasted, and the time wasted are absolutely incalculable.

From the original Shinano Allied Forces, more than half of the domestic soldiers and horses were assembled to fight against the dojo army under Iiyama Castle, but they could only gather more than 2,000 second-level warriors, and there were really not many other than that. You can see it.

The entire Shinano country is added up and cultivated with the power of one country, but it can only get together a second-order of about 3,000.

If you want to cultivate 5,000 second-tier powerhouses, in terms of Japan's traditional power system, you need two countries, and you still need a stronger country to support them.

Now the 5,000 second-order can be thrown away as soon as they are thrown away, so straightforward, it can't help but make these shady people feel surprised and admired.

These people asked themselves, if they encountered such a scene, even if they knew that if they did not do so, they might end up with annihilation of the whole army, but it would be difficult for them to make up their minds to sacrifice the 5,000 elites to save the army.

In the distance, Tomita Yoshinari, who had suffered a backlash all over his body due to the collapse of the giant sword just now, and sprayed several mouthfuls of blood, now his face is like gold paper. All languished down.

The leader of the man in black saw Tomita Yoshinari's appearance, his mind moved, and his eyes lit up.

However, he understands that the price he needs to pay to activate this kind of formation is really too high. Even for him, in order to activate the 18 Tianzhu extinction net, he also consumed several long-inherited strange objects. able to hold on.

Coupled with the medicine that nourishes the spirit and flesh, this forced a sigh of relief, so that the body did not suffer much damage and maintained about 80% of its strength.

But now the general on the opposite side doesn't seem to have any strange things. He marched in a hurry, and he didn't have time to prepare any hanging medicine. Thinking about it, he never thought that he would suffer such a situation.

So now, after Tomita Yoshinari activated the formation, nine out of ten of his strength has been lost, his body has also been severely injured, and he looks sick and tired.

This situation couldn't help but make the leader of the Black Mist people who hadn't fled far away feel trembling all over his body, and he, who was originally desperate, once again ignited a raging flame of hope.

Looking at the current situation of the leader, most of the whole person is crippled, and it is impossible to use any swordsmanship.

And the bloody long dragon formed by the enemy's remaining army array has already shrunk several times after such a long period of consumption, and coupled with the shock of the army's morale just now, it has completely collapsed.

Looking at the faces of those soldiers, all of them exuded panic and exhaustion. It was obviously impossible to form an army formation again, and they didn't want to.

Because these soldiers can't be sure, after forming an army formation, whether the attack they will use will be the same as those of the second-rank warriors just now, draining their blood, and then turning into a dry body and dying.

Therefore, these large armies have been abolished, and it is impossible to form an army formation to fight.

In addition, the current consumption of physical strength is too great, and the strength is also worn out, so there is no threat to the fourth- and fifth-level powerhouses like himself.

"Maybe there's still work to be done."

The leader of the black mist man said inwardly, and turned his head to look at several subordinates around him. And moved.

"In that case, let's do it."

Take advantage of his illness and kill him.

Now the army that invaded the Shinano country has consumed too much strength and has fallen into the lowest point in history.

If we don't destroy them when they are at their weakest, and wait until the army recuperates and recovers their strength again, then we won't have such a good opportunity to build a large formation and wear them down slowly.

So the present opportunity is once in a thousand years, if you really give up, I am afraid that these black mist people will be very unwilling to think about it in the future, and maybe they will give birth to inner demons, so they will disappear.

So under Tomita Yoshinari's uneasy eyes, the remaining five men in black quickly ran towards him again, their figures scattered in all directions, vaguely appearing to be surrounded.

"This damn mouse dares to come here to offend. It's really haunting, hateful, hateful."

Tomita Yoshinari cursed again and again, but there was nothing he could do. Now he has lost all his strength, even if he wants to, he is powerless.

However, he is not too worried about his own safety. There are 11 fourth-tier guards around him, and they have formed a formation. Just because these five people want to break through to him and kill him , easier said than done.

What's more, Tomita Yoshinari's strength has been greatly damaged now, and he has not completely lost the power to resist. In this way, he is also a fifth-order powerhouse, how could he really have no ability to resist danger at all.

So he just cursed, and then ordered the few subordinates around him to intercept.

However, he didn't expect that four of the five men in black who rushed over would suddenly be separated, and their auras rose suddenly, which seemed to have activated some kind of cultivation technique that quickly increased their strength. Although this kind of exercise can increase strength for a while, it is just like the giant sword formation just now. But it can only last for a while, and then the body will collapse due to excessive absorption of strength, and then die.

Many people will not use it unless it is absolutely necessary, such as when they are forced to a dead end and are ready to fight to the death, pulling the enemy to die together.

Now, these black mist men actually used it when besieging him, which made him feel bad.

Sure enough, the strength of the four Heiwu people who had cast the secret power-enhancing technique suddenly increased, holding back the 11 guards in a few strokes, opening a passage between them, and then the fifth-level cultivator The leader of the group rushed forward quickly, and the target was Tomita Yoshinari.

Capture the thief first and capture the king first.

The leader knew very well that the commander in chief of this army is the man in front of him. As long as he is killed, the remaining army is unlikely to collapse, but it will be completely abolished, and there will be no strength to make progress.

Next, as long as the local tyrants of the Shinano Kingdom work harder to defeat the remaining army and restore all the land, it will not be difficult.

So his goal is very clear, that is to kill Tomita Yoshinari. For this goal, even if everyone is sacrificed, he had this awareness long before he came.
